summary: The proof rigorously establishes the halfspace bound (1), including the residual-rank-zero and singleton cases, but the claimed consequence (2) is not justified from the supplied candidate because h_S is never defined.
gaps: The symbol h_S(y) is undefined in the candidate and in both supplied predecessor facts. Therefore the displayed definition h_max(C)=sup_{y in S} h_S(y) gives no relation between h_S(y) and the infimum of the mixed volumes of closed halfspaces containing y. The final assertion that (2) follows from (1) cannot be verified using only the supplied material.
repair_hints: Explicitly define h_S(y) as the infimum of H_d(S intersect H) over closed halfspaces H containing y before defining h_max(C); then (1) immediately implies (2).
